items.name: riser
items.text: A short bright upward whoosh riser that builds quickly, for text flying up in a motion graphics video. No music.

items.name: stamp
items.text: A heavy rubber stamp slamming down on paper on a desk, one solid thud with a tiny paper rattle. No music.

items.name: tick
items.text: A fast mechanical stopwatch ticking quickly, about eight ticks, clean and close. No music.

items.name: sparkle
items.text: A short magical sparkle shimmer with soft bells, for a reward or celebration moment. No music.

items.name: paper
items.text: A sheet of paper slapping down onto a wooden desk, quick and crisp. No music.

items.name: boom
items.text: A deep soft cinematic boom impact with a short rumble tail, for a big title slam. No music.

items.name: swipe
items.text: A very fast whip pan swish, short airy transition, clean. No music.

items.name: confetti
items.text: A small confetti popper burst followed by light paper flutter. No music.
